plan.title: Vendor view with pending counter offer

steps.note: Open an existing RFQ with a pending counter offer rather than creating a new event.
Move to the separate vendor portal session while keeping the buyer session available.
Open the event overview where the pending counter offer and its response action are shown.
Assert that the vendor can accept the pending counter offer.
Assert that the vendor view identifies the pending counter offer.
Attempt to observe the expected reject response; the exact control label is not confirmed by the catalog.
Open the pricing round so the vendor’s price-editing behavior can be tested.
Verify that the vendor cannot edit the price while the counter offer remains pending.
